name: jbl-charge4-10s
script: This is the JBL Charge 4. Inside, one driver makes the sound, two passive radiators pump out the bass, and a seventy-five hundred milliamp-hour battery powers it all.

facts.battery: 7,500 mAh / 27 Wh, 3.6 V Li-ion, pack IAA011NA = 3 x Samsung 18650 in parallel (52audio teardown); 20 h (JBL)
facts.driver: one 50 x 90 mm racetrack driver, 4-lobe star phase plug, front-left of chassis, 4 screws (spec page, 52audio, iFixit photos)
facts.radiators: two passive radiators, one per end; grey hatched plate ('!JBL' / '!'), clip on and seal out water (JBL renders, iFixit)

shots.visual: Closed speaker on black star field, slow eased orbit from 3/4 left. Caption label 'JBL Charge 4' + '2018' fades in under it on 'JBL' (0.86).

shots.vo: Inside, one driver makes the sound.
shots.visual: On 'Inside' the fabric cover (badge, top controls, back CHARGE4 panel) lifts off and fades, showing the black chassis with the driver mounted front-left behind an orange gasket. On 'driver' (3.6) cyan outline + 'Driver / 50 x 90 mm'; cone moves.

shots.vo: Two passive radiators pump out the bass,
shots.visual: Camera pulls back; both radiators slide out of their bumpers on 'Two' (5.2), outlined on 'passive', label with two leader lines on 'radiators' (5.84), pump hard on 'pump' (6.42), slide home on 'and'.

shots.vo: and a 7,500 milliamp-hour battery powers it all.
shots.visual: Bottom foot/cover drops and fades on 'and' (7.76); the blue 3-cell pack drops out and floats in front, outlined; label 'Battery / 7,500 mAh / 3 x 18650 cells' on '7,500' (8.2). On 'powers' (10.16) everything goes back, fabric returns, the 5 battery LEDs fill up one by one.

music_cues.title: Hidden Fields
music_cues.why: hopeful light indie-pop, 120 bpm, matches the upbeat 'discovery' bed of the Jared Owen reference
